# Data Description

UCDP Country-Year Dataset on Organized Violence within Country Borders version 26.1 *link: https://ucdp.uu.se/downloads/#orgviocy*

Shawn Davies, Therése Pettersson, Magnus Öberg, Organized violence 1989–2025, and violent political protests, Journal of Peace Research, 2026. https://doi.org/10.1093/jopres/xjag046

# Analysis of UCDP Data

Determine which countries have experiences long periods of conflict, and have at least 10 years of post-conflict information available.

Sundberg, Ralph and Erik Melander (2013) Introducing the UCDP Georeferenced Event Dataset. Journal of Peace Research 50(4).

```{python}
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
```

```{python}
ucdp = pd.read_csv("/Users/School/GitHub/HHEI/Data/Public_UCDP_ViolencebyCountry.csv")
```

```{python}
ucdp.head()
```

```{python}
violence_types = ucdp.groupby("country").agg(
    first_year=('year', 'min'),
    last_year=('year', 'max'),
    total_years=('year', 'count'),
    state_based = ('sb_exist', 'any'),
    non_state = ('ns_exist', 'any'),
    one_sided = ('os_exist', 'any')
).reset_index()

summary['overall_years'] = (summary['last_year'] - summary['first_year'] + 1)
print(summary[[countycy, 'first_year', 'last_year', 'overall_years', 'state_based', 'non_state', 'one_sided']].sort_values(by='country', ascending=False))
```
